_source.title: 分类索引
_source.remarks.text.0: 本分类索引用于索引指定库内的分类，其中库 UUID 和库类型仅作针对于本索引的识别用途，防止将不同库内的索引互相引用从而引发错误
_source.deprecated: since EDA v3.2; dropped EDA v3.3

title: Classification index
remarks.text.0: This classification index is used to index the classifications in the specified library. The library UUID and library type are only used for identification purposes of this index, to prevent indexes in different libraries from referencing each other and causing errors
deprecated: since EDA v3.2; dropped EDA v3.3
